facts.value: CSC ServiceWorks, Inc. (with CSC ServiceWorks Holdings, Inc., Spin Holdco Inc. and CSC Fenway, Inc.), owned by Pamplona Capital Partners III, L.P. ("CSC/Pamplona")
Strategic: CSC is a Pamplona-owned laundry facilities operating company; Pamplona funds the price by equity commitment
Target-led (Target interest: BofA call to Party A, 04/08/2013)
None reported (the 2011-2012 Discussions concerned Mac-Gray acquiring CSC, not a sale of Mac-Gray)

facts.value: BofA Merrill Lynch (Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Incorporated)

After BofA Merrill Lynch sounded out Party A in April 2013, Party A made an unsolicited $17.00-$19.00 proposal on 06/21/2013. A Special Committee then had BofA approach 50 parties; 20 signed confidentiality agreements and three submitted preliminary indications in July. Four bidders, including Party A, received management meetings and staged data access, with strategic bidders shown less customer data. Revised proposals in September ranged from $16.00 to $19.50, and in the final round CSC/Pamplona bid $20.75 against Party B's $19.00 cash plus performance options and Party A's unchanged range. The committee countered at $21.25, CSC/Pamplona accepted in exchange for exclusivity, and the merger agreement was signed on 10/14/2013 at $21.25 per share in cash.

findings.title: R01 decided: bidder-commitment changes as same-price bids
findings.detail: Whether termination-fee and sponsor-guarantee changes communicated at an unchanged price receive separate same-price Bid events or remain dated terms in Notes. Austin decided by whether the term changes the bidder's ability to walk away.
findings.proposed_change: Check the displayed extraction against the decision: the September 21-23 final package and the October 5 and October 8 sponsor-liability proposals are same-price Bids; the October 7 and October 11 target-fee terms stay in dated Notes.

recorded_decision.decision: Bidder-commitment changes (reverse termination fee, sponsor damages cap or guarantee, adding or dropping a financing or closing condition) are same-price Bids carrying the standing price; the target termination fee stays in a dated Note; target requirements on the bidder's commitment are Other material event.
